source_membership: Complete recursive git ls-tree: two production files, four original test/support/benchmark/fuzz files and BUILD.bazel (1,298 lines). No doc.go, generated source/input, platform/build-tag variant, external fixture or checked-in fuzz corpus.
removed_owners: RangeFile and all generic payload adapters
local KeyRange substituted at both generated RPC result boundaries

original_support_mapping.TestRangeTree search/assertIncomplete/as: RangeTree::get and inline assertion helpers; exhaustive original byte-bound ranges retained
original_support_mapping.TestRangeTreePutForce expectedRange/chec: inline tuple cases and check helper, all 18 files retained
original_support_mapping.makeEncodeKeyspacedTableRecord/testRange: rtree::tests::encode_keyspaced_table_record and range_tree_merge, both classic and V2 subcases with 10,000 ranges each
original_support_mapping.buildProgressRange/buildProgressRangeWit: rtree::tests::build_progress_range/build_progress_range_with_physical_id return shared records, retained by the original callback tests.
original_support_mapping.getFiles: rtree::tests::get_files; full generated files with source bounds and checksums
original_support_mapping.metautil.MetaWriter + objstore local fix: Original Go case exercised the actual temporary local-storage writer. Rust recording MetaSink covers every source checksum/callback assertion plus shared generated payload identity; actual Rust object storage remains unintegrated.
original_support_mapping.TestMain: Original SetupForCommonTest/goleak harness executed with its five ignores; Rust standard test harness and synchronous bounded test state, no spawned production worker in this package.

original_benchmark_mapping.BenchmarkRangeTreeUpdate: rtree::tests::benchmark_range_tree_update; source update loop executed for 100,000 iterations, with final length/coverage assertions. Original Go workload run at -benchtime=100000x; no timing equivalence claim.

original_fuzz_mapping.FuzzMerge: rtree::tests::fuzz_merge_seed_corpus; original single index-key pair preserved. Original Go -race unit run executes its seed. No sustained mutation fuzz campaign or native fuzz harness acceptance claimed.

build_mapping: BUILD.bazel library/test targets and eight test shards map to the existing tidb-br Cargo library/inline tests. Shared Cargo manifest/lock unchanged; no feature, build.rs or platform source in tidb-br. Reference Go checkout runs required bazel_prepare before tests; no main-tree Go/Bazel changes.

dependencies.generated_owner: Existing tidb-proto backup and kvrpcpb re-exports; inputs, outputs and all module artifacts in shared-client-contracts-inventory.json, checked by lint.
dependencies.google_btree: Existing BTreeMap native representation; no new acceptance of the external btree module.
dependencies.metautil: MetaSink and ChecksumStats remain explicit dependency boundaries; this repair makes their file payload concrete, without implementing object storage.
dependencies.codec_summary_logging: Existing table-key codec, local V2 decoder and diagnostic/summary integration limits unchanged; those external package owners are not accepted here.

integration: Every range/progress tree, metadata sink and restore caller uses Arc<backup.File>; both gap APIs return generated kvrpcpb.KeyRange. Distinct Go-local algebra KeyRange remains. No external production caller or BRIE dispatch exists.
acceptance_scope: Complete package review and atomic P05 protocol/progress-ownership repair. The retained progress-handle limitation is closed by the linked follow-up; no claim of live backup/restore, dependency-package or whole-crate acceptance.
